resources.string: Release builds require HTTPS. The panel handles passwords; native storage never saves them.
Panel locked\nUnlock with device credentials or biometrics
Enter a complete HTTPS panel URL without credentials, temporary tokens, query parameters or fragments. QA builds allow loopback HTTP only.
Clearing the previous session. Please try again shortly.
Navigation to another origin was blocked. Open it separately in a browser; the panel session is not forwarded.
Certificate verification failed. Configure a trusted HTTPS certificate for the panel before reconnecting.
Connection failed. Check the panel URL, network and certificate before trying again.
Management downloads are not automated. Sign in with a trusted browser to download; this app never forwards the session to a system download service.
Device security is not configured. Sign out, or enable a secure device lock before unlocking.
Use device biometrics or lock-screen credentials
The panel remains locked. Unlock it or sign out.
Clearing cookies, web storage and cache…
Local session cleared. Reconnecting requires panel login. Previous server sessions retain their original expiry.
The web process exited and local login state was cleared. Reconnect and sign in; the previous session is not automatically restored.
Optional: allow local network access for a LAN panel
Local network access is granted. Connect to your HTTPS panel manually; this app does not scan the network or reconnect automatically.
